_comment: postgres: read-only inspection of the local dev database (erp-app-reference/docker/docker-compose.yml)
through the reference MCP Postgres server, started with npx (Node 20+; every query runs in a READ ONLY
transaction). The connection URL is assembled from the same DB_* variables .env.example and
docker-compose.yml use; Claude Code expands them from its own environment, so export them before
launching (set -a && source .env && set +a) or the defaults below apply. On native Windows, if the
client cannot spawn npx directly, use "command": "cmd", "args": ["/c", "npx", ...].
Alternative once uv is installed: `uvx postgres-mcp --access-mode=restricted` with DATABASE_URI set
